name: Assisi
tagline: St Francis's hill town in green Umbria
summary: The pink-stone hill town of St Francis and St Clare, with the great Basilica of St Francis and its Giotto frescoes. Pilgrims and art lovers come for the churches and the hermitages in the woods, and stay for the quiet Umbrian countryside of olive groves and hill towns.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal. 4 October, the feast of St Francis, is the busiest day; summers are hot.
arrival: Trains from Rome (about 2 hours) and Florence (about 2.5 hours) stop at Santa Maria degli Angeli, a 10-minute bus below the town. Perugia airport is 15 minutes away.
gettingAround: The hill town is walkable but steep; buses run to the station and the valley.
cashTip: Cards work widely; carry coins for candles and small cafés.
foodTip: Umbrian food: strangozzi pasta with black truffle, torta al testo flatbread, wild boar and Sagrantino wine.
buyTip: Religious art, Franciscan crafts, Deruta ceramics, truffles and olive oil.
baseArea: Inside the old walls near Piazza del Comune

items.name: Basilica of St Francis
items.summary: Two stacked churches over the tomb of St Francis, covered in frescoes by Giotto, Cimabue and others.
items.expect: Free; silence and covered shoulders; no photos inside.
items.tip: Visit the crypt with St Francis's tomb, then the Giotto cycle in the Upper Church.
